visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a macro close-up of vibrant red plums encased in a thick, textured brown plum sauce, resting in a glass bowl. Green mint leaves are arranged neatly at the base of the frame, providing a sharp color contrast against the warm red and brown tones of the food. White text overlays appear at the top. (2) A male chef wearing a professional white culinary jacket with pink floral accents on the sleeves is seen scoring the skin of a plum with a small paring knife. His hands are steady as he makes shallow vertical cuts around the fruit. The background is a clean, neutral studio setting with bright, even lighting that highlights the glossy texture of the fruit and the sharp edge of the blade. (3) The scene shifts to a glass bowl where hands are vigorously rubbing large, coarse white salt crystals onto a pile of plums. The friction causes some salt to fly as the plums are tumbled together. Yellow and white informative text blocks appear on the right side of the screen detailing the quantity and the purpose of this step. (4) The chef stands in a medium shot, holding two plums covered in salt and moisture, demonstrating the effect of the curing process. He speaks directly to the camera with an expressive face. The background features a simple green wall and a white pegboard with kitchen utensils hanging on it, maintaining a professional yet domestic atmosphere. (5) In a close-up shot, plums are dropped into a pot of rolling, bubbling boiling water. A metal slotted spoon is used to swirl the fruit around. The steam rises visibly from the surface. (6) The blanched plums are then placed in a bowl, and a person pours light brown granulated sugar and fine yellow ginger powder from small glass containers over them. The powders coat the wet surfaces of the fruit instantly. (7) The final shot returns to the beautifully plated plums in the glass bowl, shimmering under studio lights with the mint leaves again visible in the foreground, presenting the finished culinary result.
visual_base.text_narrative_log: (1) [Subtitle]: 梅香醃李子. [Logo]: wecook123. (2) [Slogan]: 李子劃刀 讓鹽巴去除 酸味 & 苦味. (3) [Slogan]: 要用粗鹽. (4) [Slogan]: 鹽巴 200g. (5) [Slogan]: 醃製大約2小時左右. (6) [Slogan]: 水滾後開始汆燙 李子30-40秒. (7) [Slogan]: 二砂糖 300g 南薑 50g 甘草粉 40g. (8) [Slogan]: 冰鎮過後會更好吃!.
